ALGER, 19/07/2026 (Algeria Tech) — Algér: ALGIERS, 07/19/2026 (Algeria Tech) — Algérie Télécom has launched the Idoomly offer, allowing users to benefit from 96 additional hours of internet after their package has been used up.
Lancement de l'offre Idoomly par Algérie: Launch of the Idoomly offer by Algérie Télécom
Algérie Télécom a introduit l'offre Idoo: Algérie Télécom has introduced the Idoomly offer, a solution designed to extend users' internet access. Activation is done in a few seconds via the My Idoom application. Once the package is exhausted, customers receive an additional 96 hours of internet, deducted from the next top-up.
Cette initiative vise à améliorer l'expé: This initiative aims to improve the subscriber experience by avoiding connection interruptions. Algérie Télécom is therefore banking on innovative services to strengthen its position in the telecommunications market in Algeria.
L'offre Idoomly permet d'obtenir 96 heur: The Idoomly offer allows you to obtain an additional 96 hours of internet after the package is exhausted.
L'activation se fait via l'application M: Activation is done via the My Idoom application in a few seconds.
Les heures supplémentaires sont déduites: Overtime is deducted from the next top-up.
Algérie Télécom renforce son offre de se: Algérie Télécom strengthens its service offering with this new functionality.
